title: feat(auth): an AI service account is a sys_user row of kind agent that never signs in
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9H3PTJ3DC1WnJJ1S3UcQwgg)_

Part of #31739

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

Clause-② measured: the published face widens by two `sys_user` columns (`principal_kind`, `accountable_user_id`), one `ReconcileOutcome` member (`agent-account`) and one new plugin-auth module (`service-account-identity.ts`). No authorable metadata key changes, so the changeset level is `patch`.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`sys_user` 新增「主体类型」与「负责人」两列，AI 服务账号是一条 `agent` 类型的用户记录；它不能登录、不能被模拟登录、不能持有密码或第三方登录绑定，成员关系自动绑定也跳过它。
- 为什么改：ADR-0151 第一步（D1 记录、D2 不登录），PR-2 的权限上限和 PR-3 的注册与密钥入口都建在这条记录上。
- 风险与回滚：每次建会话多读一次本人的 `sys_user` 行；读失败时仍拒绝（宁拒勿放），但返回 503「用户记录读取失败，请重试」并记录原因，不会把人误报成 AI 服务账号。现有用户都按「人」处理，行为不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/service-account-identity.ts`（拒绝与行守卫，留意 catch 分支）、`auth-manager-database-hooks.ts`（会话与凭证钩子的接入点）、`reconcile-membership.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/service-account-sign-in-refusal.test.ts src/service-account-identity.test.ts`，应见 32 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **D1, the row.** `sys_user` gains `principal_kind` (`human` default, or `agent`) and `accountable_user_id` (a lookup to `sys_user`). Both are `readonly` and listed in the D7 managed-extension set, so the generic data path never writes them.
- **D1 rules, every writer including the system.** A new `sys_user` row guard (priority 4, before the identity write guard) holds three rules. A user's kind is set at creation and never changes. An `agent` row names an existing person as its owner, never itself and never another account. A person names no owner. Refusals are `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` with ADR-0114 field codes (`required`, `reference_not_found`, `invalid_value`).
- **D2, no session.** `session.create.before` first refuses an `agent` user with `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`. better-auth routes every session through `internalAdapter.createSession`, so this covers password, magic link, one-time code, passkey, social and SSO sign-in, impersonation and the server-side principal-session mint.
- **D2, no credential.** `account.create.before` refuses a `sys_account` row (a password or a provider link) for an `agent` user.
- **A failed read of the user row.** Both refusals fail closed, but as an outage: `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` with "the user record could not be read … try again", and the cause logged once (class and message, never the session or credential). A person never sees the AI service account refusal because the database blinked.
- **Membership.** `reconcileMembership` answers the new outcome `agent-account` and binds nothing. The one-time backfill skips `agent` rows.
- **Translations.** The two new columns are translated in all ten locales; `en` is regenerated.

Nothing registers an AI service account yet. The agent ceiling and key admission (PR-2) and the registration, key and lifecycle doors (PR-3) follow, each from a fresh main.

## Tests

New, 32 cases:
- `service-account-identity.test.ts` (19, real ObjectQL + SQLite): born with its kind, kind immutable for system, multi-row and user-context writes, the owner rules, the reconciler and backfill exemption, and CONTROLs for people.
- `service-account-sign-in-refusal.test.ts` (13, AuthManager on the shared memory engine): password, magic link, impersonation, principal-session mint, `internalAdapter.createSession`, `createAccount`/`linkAccount` refused with no row written; a failed row read refuses both as a 503 read fault with the cause logged; CONTROLs where a person signs in, is impersonated and links a provider as before.

Forced test edits, all in `first-session-membership-ordering.test.ts`, because the session hook now reads the user's own row first:
- `a no-bind sign-in costs NO extra membership read — the re-read is gated on the outcome`: `find` was "never called"; it is now "called exactly once, with the `sys_user` principal-kind read". The membership read count is unchanged.
- `a sign-in that created nobody costs no read beyond the original selection`: the same edit.
- `a broken engine never breaks session create`: the double's `find` now answers the `sys_user` read and still fails every membership read. A failed principal-kind read refuses the session on purpose, pinned in the new sign-in refusal file.

## Acceptance notes

- PR-1 of the approved three-PR serial split (D1+D2). The card stays open.
- The same-organisation rule for the owner is left to the PR-3 registration door, which knows the organisation.
- ADR-0151's status line still reads "Proposed" although it merged; flagged to the seat, not touched here.
- Seat: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER review owed on this PR.

## Verification

<details><summary>Tests and typecheck</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test` (lock): 248 files passed, 4438 passed / 10 skipped, at 9a03a667 and again at d2d101d0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: 120 files, 1931 passed.
- `tsc --noEmit` for plugin-auth and platform-objects: exit 0.
- `eslint packages/plugins/plugin-auth packages/platform-objects --no-inline-config`: exit 0.
- `check-i18n-bundles`: all bundles in sync.
- After the read-fault change: `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary`, `check:error-status-conformance`, `check:error-code-casing` and plugin-auth eslint exit 0.
- After merging main (9a03a667): the three touched test files, 52 passed; full `pnpm build` 119/119.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each red, then restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty)</summary>

Each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; the named pin went red and the file came back with blob == HEAD.
1. Session refusal removed from `session.create.before`: password, magic link, impersonation, mint and createSession pins red.
2. Credential refusal removed from `account.create.before`: createAccount/linkAccount pin red.
3. Kind-change check removed from the row guard: immutability pins red.
4. Owner-required check removed: owner pins red.
5. Reconciler exemption removed: reconciler pin red.
6. Backfill skip removed: backfill pin red.
7. Person-with-owner check removed: person-owner pin red.
8. Session refusal fails open on a read error: "a session whose user row cannot be read is refused" red.
9. Credential refusal fails open on a read error: "a credential whose user row cannot be read is refused" red.

After seat review (read-fault refusal, d2d101d0):
10. Session read fault answers the AI service account refusal instead: "a session whose user row cannot be read is refused as a read fault, and the cause is logged" red.
11. Credential read fault answers the AI service account refusal instead: the credential twin red.
12. The cause log removed (`console.warn(` → `String(`): both read-fault pins red. A first attempt at this leg (`void (` with a trailing comma) failed to transform, so it measured nothing; it was replaced by this one.

</details>

<details><summary>Dispatch gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran`: 77 derived, 77 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, every exit 0.
- `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary` first flagged the three field codes stamped through a parameter; the refusal helper now takes one literal ADR-0114 field entry, and the gate passes.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and the teardown self-test ran after a full build and a fetch of their pinned commit.

</details>
